evidence: With the causal attention model converging, exploring the sequence ensemble architecture provides a new approved direction. We evaluate it using a restricted hidden dimensionality of 16, which previously proved optimal for generalization on sparse sequential histories.
expected_effect: The sequence ensemble will improve GAUC and nDCG over the pointwise baseline by integrating temporal patterns, with the reduced hidden capacity acting as implicit regularization to prevent overfitting.
hypothesis: Deploying a sequence ensemble architecture with a constrained hidden_dim of 16 will outperform the baseline by robustly capturing sequential user preferences without overfitting.

research_sources.summary: SASRec motivates causal self-attention over user interaction histories for sequential recommendation.
research_sources.title: Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation
